description: Reverse search over a typed spec layer: pass a category and engineering requirements, get every catalogued item grouped as A (meets all stated requirements), B (fails a named requirement, both figures quoted) or C (could fit, data missing). Verdicts cite the datasheet page. Omit parameters you do not care about. Categories: reaction-wheels, star-trackers, obc-computers, batteries, radios, solar-panels, propulsion, sun-sensors, magnetometers, magnetorquers, imus-gyros, gnss-receivers, eps, deployers, thermal, antennas, sdr-modems, cameras, structures, platforms, ground-stations, sadm, tanks-valves, separation-systems, pointing-mechanisms, test-facilities (environmental test labs — items are companies: test, shaker_min_kn, tvac_min_m, specimen_min_kg, emc_min_m). The answer is compact: group A in full (up to 25), groups B and C — the first 10 with the reason, plus counts and the fields most often unpublished in C; page with group and offset.

accuracy_max.description: star trackers: worst acceptable cross-boresight accuracy, arcsec

acq_max.description: star trackers: max lost-in-space acquisition time, s

arw_max.description: IMU: worst angle random walk, deg per sqrt hour

bus_v.description: your power bus voltage, V — the unit must accept it

buspower_min_w.description: platforms: min orbit-average power generation, W

capacity_min_u.description: deployer: min capacity, U (your satellite size)

category.description: which component class to search — ONE per call; for several classes call once per class (default reaction-wheels)

data_if.description: required data interface: CAN, RS-422, RS-485, SpaceWire, I2C, SPI, UART, MIL-STD-1553

dish_min_m.description: ground station: min antenna diameter, m

emc_min_m.description: test-facilities: min test-article size the EMC / anechoic chamber takes, m

exclude_company.description: manufacturer names to EXCLUDE, comma-separated (for "not from Sodern")

exclude_country.description: countries or a region to EXCLUDE — "China", "Russia, Belarus", "Asia" (for "not Chinese", "non-US")

export.description: required export status: ITAR-free | EAR99 | ITAR

flight_proven.description: any category: true = only products with stated flight heritage (missions flown, heritage text or TRL 9)

form_u.description: structures / platforms: CubeSat size, U (exact match)

fov_min_deg.description: sun sensors / star trackers / cameras: min field of view, deg

group.description: page through one group only — use with offset from paging.next

gsd_max_m.description: camera: worst ground sample distance, m

life_min_y.description: any category: min design life in orbit, years

limit.description: items of groups B and C to return (default 10, max 50); group A comes in full up to 25

link_band.description: platforms: radio band of the bus — UHF | VHF | L | S | X | Ku | Ka | optical

momentum_min.description: wheels: min angular momentum storage, N*m*s

offset.description: start position inside the group (paging.next.offset of the previous answer)

orbit.description: platforms: orbit the bus is designed for — LEO | SSO | VLEO | MEO | GEO | HEO | lunar | deep space (LEO, SSO and VLEO pass each other)

outpow_min_w.description: EPS: min total output power, W

panel_power_min_w.description: solar panel: min BOL output, W

paymass_min_g.description: platforms / deployers / separation systems: payload or satellite mass that must fit, grams

paypower_min_w.description: platforms: min orbit-average power available to the payload, W

payvol_min_l.description: platforms: min volume for the payload, litres

payvol_min_u.description: platforms: min volume for the payload, U

pointacc_max_deg.description: platforms / pointing mechanisms / ground stations: worst acceptable pointing accuracy, deg (30 arcsec = 0.0083)

power_max.description: max steady-state power, W (peak/regenerative not counted)

price_max_eur.description: max indicative price, EUR (few vendors publish it — expect group C)

prop_type.description: propulsion: electric | chemical | cold-gas | water; platforms: electric | chemical | any (the bus carries propulsion)

specimen_min_kg.description: test-facilities: mass of your test article the lab must take, kg

sun_excl_max.description: star trackers: max acceptable sun exclusion angle, deg

sunacc_max.description: sun sensor: worst acceptable accuracy, deg

test.description: test-facilities: kinds of test the lab must ALL offer, comma-separated — vibration, shock, thermal-vacuum, thermal, emc, radiation, acoustic, magnetic, rf-antenna, mass-properties, outgassing, optical

tid_min.description: any category: min radiation tolerance TID, krad

tvac_min_m.description: test-facilities: min usable inner size (diameter or smallest side) of the thermal-vacuum chamber, m

txpow_min_w.description: radio: min TX RF power, W

update_min.description: star trackers: min update rate, Hz

name: match_components
